exposure: Pre-oxygenation with PEEP in supine position
Pre-oxygenation without PEEP in supine position
Pre-oxygenation with PEEP in propped up position
cohort: 60 patients scheduled for elective/emergency cesarean section under general anesthesia
finding: While all groups achieved target ETO2, the propped-up position with PEEP achieved it fastest, although no significant hemodynamic differences were found between groups.
